heading.en: Redemption comes through the Holy Messiah—Freedom of choice (agency) is essential to existence and progression—Adam fell that men might be—Men are free to choose liberty and eternal life. About 588–570 B.C.
heading.sm: O le togiolaina e oo mai e ala i le Mesia Paia—O le filifiliga saoloto (faitalia) ua taua i le olaga ma le alualu i luma—Na pa'ū Atamu ina ia i ai le tagata—Ua saoloto tagata e filifili le saolotoga ma le ola e faavavau. E tusa o le 588–570 T.L.M.

w.en: and things to be acted upon.
